data.name: Bariq
data.gender_notes: Bariq is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Lightning in the sky. The name Bariq carries the meaning “Meteor” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Bariq usually hope their child will grow to embody meteor and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Bariq is a name of Allah, which means the shining star, the one who illuminates the darkness of the universe. It represents the spiritual enlightenment and the ability to see the truth in all its glory.
data.etymology: Bariq belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Meteor.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Bariq total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_arabic.name: بارق
in_arabic.meaning: بارق يعني الوميض أو الضوء السريع أو البرق
in_arabic.long_meaning: بارق هو اسم مشتق من الفعل 'برق' الذي يعني الوميض أو الضوء السريع، وغالبًا ما يرتبط بالبرق في السماء. في اللغة العربية، يُستخدم هذا الاسم للإشارة إلى الشخص الذي يأتي ببرق أو نور، وقد يكون له دلالات روحية متعلقة بالإيمان أو الإلهام. في بعض السياقات، قد يشير إلى السرعة أو الاندفاع.

in_urdu.name: بارق
in_urdu.meaning: بارق کا مطلب ہے وميض یا تیز روشنی، اکثر برق کے ساتھ منسلک
in_urdu.long_meaning: بارق ایک عربی نام ہے جس کا مطلب ہے وميض یا تیز روشنی، جو برق سے متعلق ہے۔ یہ نام جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمانوں میں مقبول ہے اور اکثر اس کے روحانی دلالات ہیں، جیسے کہ نور یا الہام سے منسلک۔ تاریخی طور پر، یہ نام ان لوگوں کے لیے استعمال ہوا ہے جو روشن خیال یا متحرک شخصیت کے حامل ہیں۔

in_hindi.name: बारिक
in_hindi.meaning: बारिक का अर्थ है तेज़ रोशनी या विद्युत चमक
in_hindi.long_meaning: बारिक एक अरबी नाम है जिसका अर्थ है तेज़ रोशनी या विद्युत चमक। यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में प्रयोग होता है और इसकी आध्यात्मिक महत्ता है, जैसे कि ज्ञान या प्रेरणा से जुड़ा होना। ऐतिहासिक रूप से, यह नाम उन व्यक्तियों के लिए दिया गया है जो बुद्धिमान या ऊर्जावान माने जाते हैं।

in_pashto.name: بارق
in_pashto.meaning: بارق د رڼا یا چټکې څپې معنی لري، ډیری وختونه د برښنا سره تړاو لري
in_pashto.long_meaning: بارق په پښتو کې یو مشهور نوم دی چې د رڼا یا چټکې څپې معنی لري. دا نوم په افغانستان او پاکستان کې د پښتنو په منځ کې کارول کیږي او ډیری وختونه د روحاني معنی لري لکه د حکمت یا الهام سره تړاو. تاريخي پلوه، دا نوم د هغو کسانو لپاره کارول شوی چې د پوهې يا دينی پوهاوي څخه برخمن دي.

in_english.name: Bariq
in_english.meaning: Bariq means lightning or a flash of light, symbolizing speed and illumination
in_english.long_meaning: The name Bariq originates from the Arabic root 'b-r-q', which means lightning or a flash of light. It is often associated with qualities like speed, agility, and illumination. In Islamic tradition, the name Bariq may symbolize spiritual enlightenment or guidance. Historically, it has been used in various Muslim cultures to signify someone who brings light or knowledge. The name carries a sense of dynamism and intellectual brightness.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Bariq" in Islamic culture is associated with the grandeur of Allah's creations in the natural world. It's mentioned in the Quran as a sign of Allah's power and omniscience. The sight of lightning in the night sky is a reminder of Allah's ability to strike with might and swiftness. In some Muslim communities, those named after this term are considered to have special qualities of energy, determination, and quick action.
data.spiritual_significance: In Islamic spirituality, the name "Bariq" holds a profound meaning associated with the spiritual illumination that comes from Allah's blessings. It represents the idea that even the manifestation of natural phenomena like lightning is a form of divine guidance and illumination, inspiring awe and submission to Allah. The name is a reminder of the spiritual power that comes from recognizing and humbly submitting to Allah's will, no matter what form it takes in the world.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Meteor" symbolizes Lightning in the sky.. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Bariq serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of meteor.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Bariq is mentioned in the Quran in Surah Al-An'am, Ayah 48 as one of the names of Allah. The name Bariq carried significant weight in that era.
